{{Top|leg}}
'''Credit cubes''' were [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in a form of a small shiny cube that was about the size of a Human hand. They were similar to [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chips]] in that one cube could hold anywhere from a small to an extremely large amount of credits.

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] paid [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] a large amount of credits with a credit cube for the [[Grand Plan/Legends|information]] Fett had given him. It was information Palpatine already knew, but he paid Fett to keep the young man silent.
